description.value: Leighton Campground sits on the shore of man-made Leighton Lake in Tunkwa Park's mid-elevation Thompson Plateau grasslands, southwest of Kamloops; stocked rainbow trout fishing, swimming, and canoeing are the main draws, and the approach is fully paved.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record points to the BC Parks Tunkwa Park page, which explicitly names Leighton as one of two campgrounds within the park ('There are campgrounds on both lakes'). The website confirms the park is active with frontcountry camping and lists reservation policies linking to frontcountry camping information, supporting reservations. OSM internet_access=no is the only direct amenity tag; all other amenity fields are unconfirmed from website content, which describes the broader park rather than Leighton-specific facilities.
concerns: OSM record is for 'Leighton Campground' specifically, but the linked website is for the broader Tunkwa Park, which contains both Tunkwa and Leighton campgrounds — Leighton-specific amenity details are not broken out on the page.
The OSM phone number (+1-250-320-9305) is attributed to the private operator Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd. and does not appear on the BC Parks website; could not confirm it is current.
No civic address in OSM; location is described only by lake/park name and access roads.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC provincial park campground on a named lake with frontcountry access; a touring cyclist riding the Kamloops–Logan Lake corridor would benefit from this listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The BC Parks contact page lists a separate general inquiry email (parkinfo@gov.bc.ca) and toll-free number (1-800-689-9025); the OSM email (parkinquiries@telus.net) appears to be the private operator's contact, not BC Parks directly.

wow_evidence: stocked rainbow trout fishing, swimming, and canoeing are the main draws; fully paved approach
